Jordan & Emily

Misslewood Estate
Beverly, Massachusetts

Begin Your Story →

Misslewood Estate sits right where the manicured gardens of the North Shore meet the open Atlantic — and Jordan and Emily’s June wedding made the most of every inch of it. Getting ready inside the historic mansion, with its sage-green trim, checkered marble floors, and chandeliers catching the morning light, felt like stepping into another era entirely.

The ceremony overlooked the ocean, white chairs fanning out across the lawn, rose petals scattered down the aisle, and nothing but blue sky and coastline stretching behind them. After the vows, we explored the estate grounds — the rose gardens in full bloom, the brick facade draped in ivy, the grand staircase framed by climbing flowers. Every corner of Misslewood offered something beautiful.

As the sun started to drop, we made our way to the rocks along the water. That golden-hour light — soft pinks and warm amber washing over the ocean — gave us some of the most stunning portraits of the season. Jordan and Emily on the rocks with the whole Atlantic behind them is the kind of image that stays with you.

If you’re planning a wedding on the North Shore, along the Massachusetts coast, or anywhere in New England, we’d love to hear from you.
